content:
The Associated Press has called the race for Texas's 28th Congressional District for Democratic incumbent Henry Cuellar, who defeated Republican Tano Tijerina on Tuesday, November 3, 2026.

With 226 of 281 precincts reporting, or about 80.4 percent, Cuellar led with 103,132 votes, or about 66.1 percent, to Tijerina's 45,559 votes, or about 29.2 percent, according to the Associated Press. Green Party candidate Marlón Durán had 7,415 votes, or about 4.8 percent.

Cuellar, of Laredo, has represented the district since 2005. Tijerina, the Webb County judge since 2015, mounted a high-profile challenge in a district that stretches from Laredo toward San Antonio.

The results remain unofficial until they are canvassed and certified.

Sources:

  • Associated Press — U.S. House, District 28, Texas election results, November 3, 2026
  • FOX 4 News — Henry Cuellar wins Texas' 28th Congressional District race
